title: AURORA Note Card
description: A note represents documentation, decisions, comments, or metadata that provides context without being a formal element of the model.

note_type.description: Category of note (decision, documentation, comment, rationale, todo, etc.)

content.description: The text content of the note

related_cards.description: IDs of cards this note relates to or documents

severity.description: Importance level (critical, high, medium, low, informational)

status.description: Status of the note (open, addressed, deprecated, resolved)

created_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when note was created

resolved_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when note was resolved or addressed

author.description: Person or team who created the note
